name: PEPE
rootCause: On September 9, PEPE stated on Twitter that PEPE’s old Telegram account had been hacked and was no longer under official control. The Twitter account "lordkeklol" has been compromised and used to perpetrate scams and is in no way affiliated with PEPE or its team members. All official information from PEPE will be released via its Twitter account in the coming weeks.
